owner: Ministry of Post and Telecommunications (MPTC), Royal Government of Cambodia; Japan grant aid
notes: Government national data center in Phnom Penh: groundbreaking July 2023, estimated completion cost ~$30 million with ~$16 million Japanese grant aid; Minister Chea Vandeth described it as core infrastructure for national digital data storage. Baxtel lists National Data Center Cambodia (Cambodian Ministry of Post and Telecommunications) with ~3 MW and an estimated Q1 2026 launch, as the Phnom Penh market's single facility under construction.
